status: design contract, Phase 1 - no benchmark data or measured results exist yet
cross_cutting_rules: No metric reported without stated denominator and sample size
No headline metric relies solely on an unvalidated LLM judge
Primary metrics gate phase completion; secondary metrics are diagnostic only
All benchmark-based metrics must name benchmark name + version
Test-set metrics reported once per architecture decision; dev splits used for iteration

metrics.name: entity_precision_recall_f1
metrics.formula: precision = correct spans / extracted spans; recall = correct spans / gold spans; f1 = harmonic mean
metrics.known_limitation: entity boundary disagreement requires a fixed annotation convention

metrics.name: normalization_accuracy_at_1_k
metrics.formula: acc@1 = exact gold identifier match / normalizable entities; acc@k = gold id in top-k candidates
metrics.required_label: gold normalized identifier per normalizable entity
metrics.known_limitation: multiple valid ontologies can apply to one entity type; must fix target ontology in advance

metrics.name: intent_accuracy_macro_f1
metrics.formula: accuracy = correct class / total; macro-F1 = unweighted mean of per-class F1 over taxonomy classes A-I
metrics.known_limitation: class D/E boundary is fuzzy, needs adjudication rules

metrics.name: constraint_field_precision_recall_f1
metrics.formula: same as entity P/R/F1 but over (field,value) pairs
metrics.known_limitation: small expected n unless class-G oversampled

metrics.name: source_set_precision_recall_f1
metrics.formula: precision = correct predicted sources / predicted sources; recall = correct predicted sources / gold sources; micro and macro reported
metrics.known_limitation: "required" is a judgment call for borderline queries; needs annotation convention

metrics.name: source_precision_recall_f1
metrics.formula: see nlu.source_set_precision_recall_f1
metrics.known_limitation: shared with NLU family

metrics.name: valid_call_rate
metrics.formula: schema-valid tool calls / total tool-call attempts
metrics.known_limitation: architecture-dependent; current free-form JSON dispatch has documented hallucinated-tool-name failures

metrics.name: execution_success_rate
metrics.formula: successful real API responses / valid-call attempts
metrics.known_limitation: depends on live external API availability at test time

metrics.name: parameter_correctness_rate
metrics.formula: calls with correct filter/argument values / total valid calls
metrics.known_limitation: requires reviewer familiar with each tool's real API schema

metrics.name: useful_result_rate
metrics.formula: calls returning >=1 result later used as cited evidence / successful calls
metrics.required_label: derived from claim-evidence links, no separate label
metrics.known_limitation: depends on downstream grounding pipeline existing

metrics.name: recall_at_k
metrics.formula: relevant docs in top-K / total relevant docs for query, K in {1,5,10,20}
metrics.known_limitation: requires sufficiently complete relevant set; pooling methodology must be documented

metrics.name: mrr
metrics.formula: mean(1/rank_of_first_relevant_result)
metrics.known_limitation: meaningful mainly for single-answer-style queries

metrics.name: precision_at_k
metrics.formula: relevant docs in top-K / K
metrics.known_limitation: penalizes queries with few true relevant docs

metrics.name: ndcg_at_k
metrics.formula: standard DCG/IDCG
metrics.known_limitation: must never be computed from binarized labels; excluded where only binary labels exist

metrics.name: hit_at_k
metrics.formula: queries with >=1 relevant doc in top-K / total queries
metrics.known_limitation: coarser than recall@K; useful mainly for multi-hop entry-point checks

metrics.name: candidate_recall_pre_rerank
metrics.formula: recall@K on fusion-stage candidates before reranking
metrics.known_limitation: only meaningful as paired comparison against post-rerank recall@K

metrics.name: source_coverage
metrics.formula: queries where correct source type was searchable / queries requiring that source
metrics.known_limitation: measures corpus/connector coverage, not ranking quality

metrics.name: evidence_coverage
metrics.formula: distinct gold-relevant facts represented in retrieved set / total gold-relevant facts
metrics.known_limitation: expensive to label; reserved for multi-hop/cross-source benchmark

metrics.name: retrieval_latency
metrics.formula: wall-clock ms per query per stage (dense, sparse, fusion, rerank)
metrics.known_limitation: machine-dependent; report hardware alongside

metrics.name: required_source_recall
metrics.formula: gold-required sources contributing >=1 used evidence / gold-required sources
metrics.required_label: gold required source set + contribution labels
metrics.known_limitation: requires claim-evidence link to exist first

metrics.name: cross_source_evidence_completeness
metrics.formula: distinct gold facts covered across contributing sources / total gold facts
metrics.known_limitation: same labeling cost as evidence_coverage

metrics.name: multi_source_answer_completion
metrics.formula: queries whose final answer synthesizes >=2 source types / total multi-source-required queries
metrics.known_limitation: catches retrieve-but-don't-cite failure mode

metrics.name: cross_source_linkage_correctness
metrics.formula: correctly linked hop points / total linkage points (multi-hop only)
metrics.known_limitation: small expected n, class-E only

metrics.name: claim_support_precision
metrics.formula: claims judged SUPPORTED / total material factual claims
metrics.known_limitation: depends directly on validated judge quality (see judge_validation)

metrics.name: unsupported_claim_rate
metrics.formula: claims judged UNSUPPORTED / total material factual claims
metrics.known_limitation: same judge dependency

metrics.name: citation_precision
metrics.formula: citations whose linked evidence supports the claim / total citations used
metrics.known_limitation: distinct from claim support precision; catches wrong-evidence-cited errors

metrics.name: citation_recall
metrics.formula: citable claims with >=1 correct citation / total citable claims
metrics.known_limitation: requires prior evidentiary-vs-inferential claim labeling

metrics.name: citation_completeness
metrics.formula: claims with adequate (sufficient, not just present) evidence / total material claims
metrics.known_limitation: "adequate" needs a concrete rubric before use as a gating metric

metrics.name: contradiction_rate
metrics.formula: claims contradicted by their own cited evidence / total factual claims
metrics.known_limitation: most safety-relevant metric in this family; never averaged into a generic hallucination blob

metrics.name: correctness
metrics.formula: qualitative: does central claim match actual evidence state
metrics.known_limitation: not fully automatable

metrics.name: completeness
metrics.formula: cited evidence set vs curated should-have-been-found reference set
metrics.known_limitation: requires retrieval benchmark to exist first

metrics.name: relevance
metrics.formula: rubric 1-5 human review
metrics.known_limitation: not deterministic

metrics.name: directness
metrics.formula: structural check: direct-answer sentence within first N sentences
metrics.known_limitation: structural proxy, not a full quality judgment

metrics.name: source_coverage_answer_level
metrics.formula: gold-required source types represented in final citations / gold-required source types
metrics.known_limitation: shares signal with multi_source_answer_completion

metrics.name: uncertainty_calibration
metrics.formula: rubric-based review against known-insufficient-evidence cases (taxonomy class H)
metrics.known_limitation: no single combined answer-quality score is ever computed from these dimensions

metrics.name: judge_parse_success_rate
metrics.formula: successfully parsed judge verdicts / total judge invocations
metrics.known_limitation: historical judge showed ~10-40% successful-judgment rate depending on context size

metrics.name: judge_human_agreement
metrics.formula: precision, recall, F1, and Cohen's kappa vs human labels on calibration subset
metrics.required_label: human-reviewed calibration labels, never reused for judge prompt tuning
metrics.known_limitation: minimum sample size and agreement bar to be set once real calibration data exists

metrics.name: v2_workflow_success
metrics.formula: conjunctive gate: usable ResearchQuery AND all gold-required sources queried AND minimum sufficient Recall@K met AND answer generated AND Claim Support Precision/Unsupported Claim Rate floor met AND no undisclosed critical tool failure
metrics.required_label: composed from nlu, retrieval, and grounding labels above
metrics.known_limitation: numeric floors for retrieval and grounding steps not set in Phase 1; calibrated later from measured score distributions

metrics.name: end_to_end_latency_p50_p95
metrics.formula: wall-clock per query, full pipeline, both percentiles reported
metrics.known_limitation: no arbitrary threshold set in Phase 1; targets calibrated from measured feasibility

metrics.name: per_stage_latency
metrics.formula: wall-clock per stage: query_understanding, source calls (per source), retrieval, reranking, generation, verification
metrics.known_limitation: must report hardware and concurrency setting alongside any number

metrics.name: llm_calls_per_query
metrics.formula: count
metrics.known_limitation: reference-only, not a target

metrics.name: tool_calls_per_query
metrics.formula: count
metrics.known_limitation: reference-only, not a target

metrics.name: tokens_per_query
metrics.formula: prompt + completion tokens, combined and by stage
metrics.known_limitation: reference-only, not a target

metrics.name: retries_per_query
metrics.formula: count, by cause (timeout/429/503/other)
metrics.known_limitation: reference-only, not a target

metrics.name: api_error_rate
metrics.formula: errors / total external calls, by source and error type
metrics.known_limitation: depends on live external API state at measurement time

metrics.name: cost_per_query
metrics.formula: token-based cost estimate at minimum
metrics.known_limitation: estimate only unless real billing data available

metrics.name: recovery_rate
metrics.formula: fault scenarios resolving to correct disclosed-partial or full answer / total injected fault scenarios
metrics.required_label: scenario pass/fail criteria fixed before running
metrics.known_limitation: requires fault-injection matrix to be frozen first (Phase 9)

metrics.name: silent_failure_rate
metrics.formula: fault scenarios producing an answer with no disclosure of the failure / total injected fault scenarios
metrics.known_limitation: most product-damaging failure mode; tracked even when recovery rate looks good

metrics.name: partial_answer_quality
metrics.formula: answer_quality metrics computed on disclosed-partial answers
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: retry_amplification
metrics.formula: mean additional latency/calls caused by retry logic per fault event
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: latency_penalty
metrics.formula: added wall-clock from fault handling vs clean-path baseline
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: gap_identification_accuracy
metrics.formula: follow-up queries correctly targeting a genuine evidence gap / total follow-up queries
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: follow_up_source_correctness
metrics.formula: follow-up calls selecting appropriate source for identified gap / total follow-up calls
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: additional_relevant_evidence_gained
metrics.formula: new cited evidence objects added post-follow-up / total evidence in final answer
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: quality_improvement_after_follow_up
metrics.formula: delta in claim_support_precision and completeness between pre- and post-follow-up draft
metrics.known_limitation: the metric that actually justifies loop cost

metrics.name: unnecessary_loop_rate
metrics.formula: follow-up rounds adding no new used evidence and no quality-metric improvement / total follow-up rounds
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: mean_loops_per_query
metrics.formula: count
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

metrics.name: loop_termination_correctness
metrics.formula: loops stopping for a valid reason / total loops, human-reviewed subset
metrics.known_limitation: n/a

baseline_comparisons_defined_not_run: retrieval: BM25-only vs dense-only vs current hybrid vs future architecture
answering: no-RAG vs current RAG vs V2 grounded generation
tool routing: free-form JSON dispatch vs schema-constrained native tool calling
agent loop: confidence-threshold verification loop vs evidence-gap-driven loop
statistical_reporting_requirements: every metric states benchmark name+version, split, and n
confidence interval or explicit too-small-for-CI statement where n supports it
judge-derived metrics additionally state judge parse-success rate and calibration agreement every time reported
arm comparisons use paired samples (identical query set) wherever possible
